review.rationale: Both plans faithfully select the gated packaged Unreal vertical slice and explicitly defer migration clearance and identity promotion. A is stronger because it cleanly separates contract, prerequisite, packaged-boundary, loop, adversarial verification, and evidence-review gates; defines resource ceilings, approval boundaries, artifact integrity, reviewer responsibility, and stop/rescope dispositions; and consistently labels unresolved thresholds and dependencies. B is highly aligned but places repeatable packaged-build production inside the availability gate before its minimal-integration phase, creating a mild sequencing ambiguity, and cites an RT-11 minimum of 20 while still treating the authoritative sampling rule as unresolved. Its evidence governance, acquisition constraints, and final review mechanics also require modest reconstruction compared with A.
